jobs.description:
Are you driven by people, motivated by success and energized by building relationships? Do you enjoy spotting opportunities, making things happen and working in a team where ambition and collaboration go hand in hand? Then this could be your next career move. 

Your role

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Robert Walters, you'll combine your commercial drive with your passion for people. You'll connect organizations with experienced professionals, develop your own network and play a key role in helping businesses find the expertise they need.

We are looking to strengthen our Interim Management team in Antwerp (Berchem). If you're ambitious, entrepreneurial and ready to take ownership of your career, we'd love to meet you.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Build and grow your own network of organizations and professionals within the Interim Management market
• Identify new business opportunities by understanding what organizations need and where you can add value
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with business partners
• Search for, assess and connect experienced professionals with the right interim management opportunities
• Manage the recruitment process from first contact through to successful placement
• Arrange interviews and ensure clear, proactive communication throughout the process
• Meet with prospective business partners and deepen existing relationships
• Proactively develop your portfolio through networking, market outreach and business development
• Work closely with your colleagues, sharing market knowledge, ideas and expertise
• Contribute to the success of the wider team while building your own track record
You'll have real ownership, clear targets and plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

 

 

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, ambitious and genuinely interested in people.

You'll bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree combined with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience within finance / operations
• Excellent Dutch and very good English communication skills
• A strong commercial mindset and a genuine drive to achieve results
• An entrepreneurial attitude and the confidence to create and pursue new opportunities
• Strong negotiation skills and a strategic approach
• A natural interest in business, people and the world of work
• A strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset
You're someone who takes initiative, enjoys a challenge and isn't afraid to pick up the phone or open a new door. You know how to build trust, you're comfortable working towards targets and you're motivated by seeing the impact of your work. Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Business Analyst Manufacturing Transformation
jobs.description:
I am currently supporting a client leading international industrial manufacturing organisation based in Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a major business transformation programme.

The organisation is undertaking a significant transformation of its core business and operational processes, including the modernisation and harmonisation of ERP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics and related business systems.

This is a business-critical transformation programme involving multiple stakeholders across manufacturing sites and functions, with a strong focus on process standardisation, operational efficiency and the transition from legacy ways of working to a modern target operating model.

Terms

 
• Freelance / Long-term contract - 12 months, with possible extensions
 
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium
 
• Hybrid: 2 days on-site per week
 
• Language: English-speaking (Dutch is beneficial)
 
• Rate: Negotiable depending on experience

Key responsibilities

 
• Analyse and document current AS-IS manufacturing and supply chain processes
 
• Define and document TO-BE processes as part of the transformation programme
 
• Lead requirements gathering across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics and Operations
 
• Facilitate workshops with business process owners, subject matter experts and key stakeholders
 
• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for standardisation and improvement
 
• Translate business requirements into clear functional requirements and specifications
 
• Perform fit-gap analysis between existing processes, business requirements and the target ERP / business systems
 
• Support the design and implementation of harmonised processes across multiple manufacturing sites
 
• Work closely with ERP functional teams, solution architects, technical teams and implementation partners
 
• Support integration and process dependencies across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehousing and Logistics
 
• Contribute to data migration, testing, UAT, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities
 
• Ensure business requirements and process documentation remain aligned throughout the transformation
 
• Act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and technical / implementation teams
 
• Support change adoption and the transition to the new processes and systems
 
• Manufacturing / supply chain experience - essential
 
• Candidates must have experience within a manufacturing environment, ideally within industrial / discrete manufacturing.

Strong experience across areas such as:

 
• Production planning and scheduling
 
• Manufacturing operations
 
• Supply Chain
 
• Procurement
 
• Inventory / materials management
 
• Warehouse and logistics
 
• MRP / planning processes
 
• Order-to-delivery processes
 
• Manufacturing master data
 
• Plant / site operations
 
• ERP-enabled manufacturing processes
 
• Experience working across multiple manufacturing sites or international operations would be highly advantageous

Project context

 
• Major manufacturing transformation programme
 
• International industrial / discrete manufacturing organisation
 
• Antwerp-based with multiple operational / manufacturing stakeholders
 
• Transformation of legacy business processes and systems
 
• Strong focus on ERP, Manufacturing and Supply Chain transformation
 
• Harmonisation and standardisation of processes across sites
 
• Transformation covering...
...

• Strong experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Functional Analyst or ERP Business Analyst

• Proven track record delivering business transformation, ERP implementation, migration or rollout programmes

• Excellent experience with AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping and fit-gap analysis

• Experience facilitating workshops with senior business stakeholders and process owners

• Comfortable working between business, functional and technical teams

• Experience working with systems integrators / implementation partners

• Experience across testing, UAT, data migration and go-live activities

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support to stores and central services, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site.
• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.
• Create, update, and maintain user documentation and operational procedures.
• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.
• Identify potential risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is mandatory.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.
• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation system (with appropriate compensation).
• Eager to learn and grow within a dynamic team environment.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

• SQL

• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.

Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.

Education & Experience

• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.	
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people. 

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization. 

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.	
• Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.	
• Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.	
• Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.	
• Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.	
• Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:
	
• Experience in a production environment.	
• Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.	
• Ability to work with a computer.	
• Good command of English or Dutch.	
• Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.	
• Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.	
• No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).	
• Physical work does not deter you.	
• Basic technical knowledge.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.

• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).

The ideal candidate should:

• Think pragmatically and solve problems.

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
